_photo_role: photo with no capture time; rider admits mess in chat; receipt matches

dispute_ticket.description: I think S$70 is too high for some mud. Can the fee be removed?

pickup_location.name: Bukit Timah Nature Reserve Visitor Centre

chat_logs.content: At the visitor centre carpark, grey Staria.
Sorry uncle, I walked the muddy trail and my shoes left clay all over your mat. I should have wiped them. Please send me the cleaning claim, I will pay.
Ok, I will send it for cleaning today and attach the receipt.

app_events.details: Rider R-5604 booked trip RYDE-PS-005 from Bukit Timah Nature Reserve Visitor Centre to Blk 410 Hougang Ave 10.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$70.00 with 1 photo and a cleaning receipt.
Receipt attached: Hougang Auto Valet, Hougang St 61, S$70.00, dated 2026-10-09 15:30.
S$70.00 cleaning fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_tiers.value: food or drink spill up to S$40; stains (mud, dirt) and bodily fluids up to S$120; vomit up to S$200
cleaning_fee_tiers.text: Usual fee by type of mess; a fee above the tier for the mess type needs a receipt.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.value: photo of the mess and a cleaning receipt where available
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt, a case officer decides; the fee is neither confirmed nor removed automatically.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Clay and mud on the rear floor mat, Hougang drop-off.

expected_outcome.reason: The photo carries no capture time or GPS, so its timing cannot be checked from the file. But the mess is independently established: at 13:55, 3 min after the 13:52 drop-off, the rider wrote in the in-app chat that clay from the trail was all over the mat and offered to pay, and a receipt for S$70 (dated 2026-10-09, Hougang Auto Valet) matches the S$70 fee, which is within the S$120 stain tier and the S$200 cap. The photo shows mud on the mat, consistent with the admission. The rider's later dispute only says the fee is high. The fee stands; refund S$0.
